purpose: Preserve public-safe research possibilities as options while limiting substantial active commitments to a small Active Frontier.
notes: This public file is not the place for confidential, personally sensitive or potential-IP-sensitive ideas.
States and evaluation dimensions are operating aids, not validated measures of scientific or economic value.
The effective adjacent possible is an established construct in recent innovation research, including Taalbi (2025/2026); Agalmic Research does not claim to originate it.
Epistemic artefact is established terminology in philosophy of science; this portfolio does not claim to originate it.
Constitutional attention is provisional local terminology for a synthesis under lineage review, not a validated novelty claim.

possibilities.title: Cognitive tools for expanding the effective adjacent possible
possibilities.summary: Develop the programme's meta aim as a lineage-grounded synthesis: cognitive tools and autonomous search systems matter insofar as they improve the capacity to generate, recognize, validate, assimilate and realize worthwhile possibilities while safely displacing whichever constraints currently limit the reachable frontier.
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A research programme and personal operating criterion oriented toward increasing reachable worthwhile futures rather than maximizing idea output.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Formalize a minimal frontier-search model that distinguishes candidate generation, epistemic artefact production, warrant, assimilation and realization; test whether constitutional attention can move human effort from item review toward objective, constraint and escalation design without unsafe specification or Goodhart effects.

possibilities.title: Distributed discovery provenance
possibilities.summary: Operationalize provenance for human-AI discovery episodes by separating framing, generation, recognition, validation, integration, realization, priority and epistemic authority using standards-first provenance.
possibilities.worthwhile_future: Research objects whose discovery process can be inspected without collapsing human and machine contributions into a single author/discoverer label.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Use the 7 September 2026 epistemic-artefacts/constitutional-attention session as the first end-to-end discovery episode; review its PROV-aligned JSON-LD, CRediT roles and local authority metadata against PROV-O/RO-Crate and document only genuine standards gaps.

possibilities.title: Economics of epistemic abundance: formalize shifting constraints
possibilities.summary: Move beyond the verbal Displaced Scarcity Hypothesis by specifying when an abundance shock changes binding constraints, shadow values, rents or market power, and distinguishing complementarity, substitution and induced-demand regimes.
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A falsifiable economics framework for understanding which scarce complements become valuable as machine cognition makes candidate production cheaper.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Construct the smallest two- or three-input model in which one input becomes abundant; test whether the proposed comparative statics say anything beyond standard bottleneck/complementarity results.

possibilities.title: Epistemic handoff pilot
possibilities.summary: Test whether claim-sensitive, provenance-preserving routing to missing expertise improves evaluation of low-authority contributions without erasing originators or overwhelming expert attention.
possibilities.lineage_status: knowledge brokerage/absorptive-capacity antecedents + narrow operational extension
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A practical route from promising outsider or machine-assisted candidates to competent validation.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Design a minimal pilot around a small set of public research claims and recruit one or two domain reviewers before specifying platform machinery.

possibilities.title: Innovation is search, but search is not enough
possibilities.summary: A research note connecting established innovation-as-search work to the machine-cognition regime, where larger search breadth can worsen the selection, testing and realization bottlenecks.
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A clearer bridge between innovation search and the economics of epistemic abundance.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Publish only if the note clarifies a testable or operational consequence not already covered by the meta-aim note.

possibilities.title: What should we make abundant next?
possibilities.summary: Examine which upstream forms of abundance, such as knowledge, algorithms, energy, compute, standards or access, most strongly expand feasible future capability sets.
possibilities.lineage_status: novelty unassessed; requires growth/capability/technology lineage review
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A way to prioritize investments in abundance-producing infrastructure by downstream frontier leverage.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Run a lineage review across endogenous growth, general-purpose technologies, capability theory, energy economics and algorithmic progress before drafting a claim.

possibilities.title: Allocation of scarce expert attention
possibilities.summary: Study mechanisms for allocating scarce specialist evaluation when candidate production outgrows expert review capacity, while avoiding credential capture, pay-to-be-heard dynamics and filter monopoly.
possibilities.lineage_status: existing expert-evaluation/attention/intermediary antecedents; narrower delta unassessed
possibilities.worthwhile_future: Higher-throughput evaluation without simply centralizing epistemic gatekeeping.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Map existing expert-review markets, peer review, prediction/forecasting, prize and intermediary mechanisms before proposing any new market design.

possibilities.title: Human-Scale Epistemic Horizon
possibilities.summary: Explore institutional consequences if reliable frontier knowledge increasingly exceeds what any individual human can personally survey or defend.
possibilities.worthwhile_future: Governance and verification architectures for knowledge beyond individual comprehension.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Keep parked until nearer-term distributed-discovery and verification work yields concrete evidence or mechanisms.

possibilities.title: Representation as discovery through Nemosyne/Moneta
possibilities.summary: Use Nemosyne/Moneta as an applied testbed for whether alternative representations can increase what analysts can notice and act upon while controlling cognitive and computational cost.
possibilities.lineage_status: broad representation/visual analytics antecedents; concrete technical novelty unassessed
possibilities.worthwhile_future: Tools that enlarge practical discovery capacity by making meaningful structure more perceptible.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Continue empirical Nemosyne verification and connect measured representation improvements to the effective-adjacent-possible framing only after evidence exists.

possibilities.title: Epistemic artefacts, assimilation and frontier formation
possibilities.summary: Distinguish outputs of directed human-machine search from assimilated knowledge by modeling epistemic artefacts, warrant, agent-relative understanding, assimilation, capability and frontier effects separately.
possibilities.lineage_status: established epistemic-artifact and epistemic-opacity antecedents + synthesis/application; novelty unassessed
possibilities.worthwhile_future: Machine-generated discoveries can be preserved, validated, routed and used without pretending that every human participant understands or can defend them.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Run a deeper philosophy-of-science, social-epistemology and distributed-cognition lineage review, then test the state model against three real discovery episodes.

possibilities.title: Constitutional attention for continuous scarcity-displacement search
possibilities.summary: Explore a governance/search architecture in which scarce human intervention shapes worthwhile-future objectives, constraints, escalation and constitutional updates while autonomous systems search for strategies that displace scarcity and expand the reachable frontier.
possibilities.lineage_status: interactive evolutionary computation + selective human oversight + autonomous discovery antecedents; terminology/synthesis novelty unassessed
lineage_sources: safe and multi-objective optimization not yet deeply reviewed
possibilities.worthwhile_future: Much larger safe search and realization capacity without requiring item-level human attention, subject mastery or review capacity to scale linearly with machine cognition.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Formalize a constrained multi-objective search model and compare it with interactive evolutionary computation, scalable oversight, safe exploration and AI-governance antecedents; identify at least one falsifiable advantage over ordinary selective oversight.
